last_known.text: Samsung to adopt TSMC 3nm process for Nvidia next-gen HBM base dies. Samsung Electronics plans to use TSMC's 3nm process to manufacture base dies for Nvidia's next-generation custom HBM, dubbed NVHBM, according to Seoul Economic Daily. Nvidia has asked Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron to standardize on TSMC's process for NVHBM base dies and on 6th-generation DRAM for core dies; Samsung reportedly accepted the requirement

Nvidia pushes TSMC 3nm process for next-gen HBM base dies. Nvidia has asked suppliers of its next-generation custom HBM memory to build the base die on TSMC's 3-nanometer process, according to The Information (Oct 19), citing Seoul Economic Daily reporting. Samsung has reportedly accepted after internal review, while SK hynix and Micron are also involved; TSMC declined to comment on individual customers.
